ms.promise:
1. Engage and engage the community
・Product: Marketing and promotion campaign implemented to attract the Vietnamese community and developers to participate in CatalystTalk. Social media activities, articles, videos, and online events will be implemented.
・Expected outcome: Increased number of members and developers participating in CatalystTalk. The Vietnamese community has become diverse and active in activities on the platform.

2. Create interaction and share ideas
・Product: Online sessions and videos will be produced and shared. Discussion, commentary, and awareness activities on Catalyst's potential in finding a career position and drawing power from their ideas.
・Expected results: Lively interaction and discussion in sharing sessions and forums. Comments and feedback from the community are collected and contributed to the decision and evaluation of projects on Cardano, members will make suggestions for their ideas with Catalyst.

To track project progress, we will use the following metrics and feedback:
・The number of users and developers involved.
・The number of ideas and projects proposed and implemented.
・The interaction and discussion in the CatalystTalk forum.
・Feedback
ms.criteria:
・Marketing CatalystTalk on forums and social platforms like Facebook, Telegram, and YouTube
・Organized 2 sessions on Catalyst Project attracting 100 participants. Publish 2 videos about 2 sharing sessions on the Youtube channel (The video is updated on the YouTube channel 24 hours after the sharing session ends, each published video reaches at least 120 views)
